title: Līloa Drive extension in Kīhei
summary: The county plans an almost mile-long, two-lane Līloa Drive extension with a bikeway, estimated at $35 million to $40 million, without enough money yet for both phases. In 2026 the department said the first phase is expected to begin in 2027.

timeline.text: The department said the first phase of the Liloa Drive extension is expected to begin in 2027.
